// defect: `stryker.config.json` sets no `concurrency`, so the run takes Stryker's own default, derived from the core count. On a machine with more cores than memory per worker that default takes the PARENT process down with it — no red, no report, no session left to read one in (`lesson-200`). Like the dry-run ceiling beside it, this is a tripwire on the setting: the failure it guards against writes nothing for a later rule to find (0077).
